games.objective: Match platform cadences to shifting tempos across pocketwatch gear interiors as coupled gears transfer momentum to neighboring puzzle rings.
games.level1Focus: Single-screen introductory layout in pocketwatch gear interiors: learn to slide pendulum weights along a two-node metronome and match platform cadences to shifting tempos with no active slipping mainspring coils.
games.level2Focus: Advanced multi-node stage in pocketwatch gear interiors: match platform cadences to shifting tempos as coupled gears transfer momentum to neighboring puzzle rings while active slipping mainspring coils force rapid repositioning.
games.implementation2D: Single-screen 2D HTML5 Canvas/JS scene with custom state variables, sprite collisions, and HUD feedback.
games.scope12Hour: Two distinct playable levels, keyboard/mouse input, clear win/lose states, and instant restart.

games.title: Hydra Potentiometer
games.description: Set inside braided delta aqueducts, this 2D strategy challenges players to slide wiper contacts along confluent-canal potentiometer arrays and divide voltage precisely between twin motors while periodic emp pulses temporarily lock the most recently used switch while steering clear of silted floodgate locks.
games.objective: Divide voltage precisely between twin motors across braided delta aqueducts while periodic emp pulses temporarily lock the most recently used switch.
games.level1Focus: Guided starter stage: practice using the confluent-canal potentiometer to divide voltage precisely between twin motors across a calm section of braided delta aqueducts.
games.level2Focus: Advanced multi-node stage in braided delta aqueducts: divide voltage precisely between twin motors while periodic emp pulses temporarily lock the most recently used switch while active silted floodgate locks force rapid repositioning.
games.implementation2D: Single-screen 2D HTML5 Canvas/JS scene with custom state variables, sprite collisions, and HUD feedback.
games.scope12Hour: Two distinct playable levels, keyboard/mouse input, clear win/lose states, and instant restart.

games.title: Isotope Stroboscope
games.description: Players operate half-life stroboscope rigs across cyclotron containment rings, working to flash shutter discs toward each unit and freeze fast-spinning gears at safe boarding gaps by chaining combos that extend the countdown timer on each clean pass before decaying particle trails block the route.
games.objective: Freeze fast-spinning gears at safe boarding gaps across cyclotron containment rings by chaining combos that extend the countdown timer on each clean pass.
games.level1Focus: Controlled tutorial room: master basic stroboscope alignment to freeze fast-spinning gears at safe boarding gaps before decaying particle trails begin cycling.
games.level2Focus: High-pressure finale: combine half-life stroboscope control with moving decaying particle trails to freeze fast-spinning gears at safe boarding gaps by chaining combos that extend the countdown timer on each clean pass.
games.implementation2D: Single-screen 2D HTML5 Canvas/JS scene with custom state variables, sprite collisions, and HUD feedback.
games.scope12Hour: Two distinct playable levels, keyboard/mouse input, clear win/lose states, and instant restart.

games.title: Jade Aperture
games.description: Navigate imperial terrace gardens by learning to iris-focus shutter blades inside jade-tablet aperture assemblies; success requires you to capture sharp silhouettes before light fades while wind gusts periodically push lightweight tokens off unguarded ledges despite cracking stone counterweights.
games.objective: Master the jade-tablet aperture to capture sharp silhouettes before light fades before cracking stone counterweights overwhelm the stage.
games.level1Focus: Single-screen introductory layout in imperial terrace gardens: learn to iris-focus shutter blades inside a two-node aperture and capture sharp silhouettes before light fades with no active cracking stone counterweights.
games.level2Focus: High-pressure finale: combine jade-tablet aperture control with moving cracking stone counterweights to capture sharp silhouettes before light fades while wind gusts periodically push lightweight tokens off unguarded ledges.
games.implementation2D: Single-screen 2D HTML5 Canvas/JS scene with custom state variables, sprite collisions, and HUD feedback.
games.scope12Hour: Two distinct playable levels, keyboard/mouse input, clear win/lose states, and instant restart.

games.title: Kaleido Bolometer
games.description: Control symmetry-shard bolometer networks within stained-glass rose windows to map hidden heat sources across dark chambers without waking sound-sensitive sentries patrolling the central walkway, timing every adjustment around misaligned symmetry axes.
games.objective: Master the symmetry-shard bolometer to map hidden heat sources across dark chambers before misaligned symmetry axes overwhelm the stage.
games.level1Focus: Guided starter stage: practice using the symmetry-shard bolometer to map hidden heat sources across dark chambers across a calm section of stained-glass rose windows.
games.level2Focus: Complex dual-target challenge: map hidden heat sources across dark chambers across split lanes in stained-glass rose windows without waking sound-sensitive sentries patrolling the central walkway and under tighter timing.
games.implementation2D: Single-screen 2D HTML5 Canvas/JS scene with custom state variables, sprite collisions, and HUD feedback.
games.scope12Hour: Two distinct playable levels, keyboard/mouse input, clear win/lose states, and instant restart.

games.title: Kinetic Clepsydra
games.description: In wind-powered kinetic sculptures, the player must meter water-drip siphons inside momentum-crank clepsydra mechanisms to time gate openings to matching vessel levels while gravity shifts 90 degrees clockwise after every fifth action, avoiding stalling gust lulls.
games.objective: Master the momentum-crank clepsydra to time gate openings to matching vessel levels before stalling gust lulls overwhelm the stage.

games.level2Focus: Complex dual-target challenge: time gate openings to matching vessel levels across split lanes in wind-powered kinetic sculptures while gravity shifts 90 degrees clockwise after every fifth action and under tighter timing.
games.implementation2D: Single-screen 2D HTML5 Canvas/JS scene with custom state variables, sprite collisions, and HUD feedback.
games.scope12Hour: Two distinct playable levels, keyboard/mouse input, clear win/lose states, and instant restart.

games.title: Loom Inclinometer
games.description: Set inside tapestry weaving lofts, this 2D adventure challenges players to balance plumb-bobs across shuttle-weft inclinometer arrays and grade steep switchbacks without tipping loads as color-coded barriers cycle through red, amber, and cyan phases while steering clear of tangled warp threads.

games.title: Luthier Planisphere
games.description: Players operate soundboard-fret planisphere rigs across acoustic workshop benches, working to spin star-wheel masks over each unit and reveal constellations that open sky portals while managing a dual-battery gauge that drains during high-speed dashes before dissonant string tension block the route.
games.objective: Use soundboard-fret planisphere controls to reveal constellations that open sky portals while managing a dual-battery gauge that drains during high-speed dashes.
games.level1Focus: Guided starter stage: practice using the soundboard-fret planisphere to reveal constellations that open sky portals across a calm section of acoustic workshop benches.
games.level2Focus: Advanced multi-node stage in acoustic workshop benches: reveal constellations that open sky portals while managing a dual-battery gauge that drains during high-speed dashes while active dissonant string tension force rapid repositioning.
games.implementation2D: Single-screen 2D HTML5 Canvas/JS scene with custom state variables, sprite collisions, and HUD feedback.

games.title: Translate Signal Beacons
games.description: Translate the signal beacons system: convert one type of movement or signal into another in order to connect distant beacons while avoiding interference zones.
games.objective: Connect distant beacons while avoiding interference zones (Translate Signal Beacons).
games.level1Focus: Starter stage for Translate Signal Beacons: learn how to translate the signal beacons system: convert one type of movement or signal into another in a calm single-screen room.
games.level2Focus: Advanced stage for Translate Signal Beacons: connect distant beacons while avoiding interference zones under tighter resource limits and moving blockers.
games.implementation2D: Single-screen 2D scene using sprites, simple physics/state variables, and a compact HUD; no 3D assets required.
games.scope12Hour: Build one polished core loop, two short levels, keyboard/mouse controls, a restart button, and clear win/lose states.

games.title: Magma Sextant
games.description: Navigate volcanic lava tubes by learning to align horizon mirrors across basalt-crust sextant assemblies; success requires you to chart safe sea lanes between moving shoals by pairing opposite polarity blocks so they lock into stable bridges despite crusting basalt vents.
games.objective: Use basalt-crust sextant controls to chart safe sea lanes between moving shoals by pairing opposite polarity blocks so they lock into stable bridges.

games.level2Focus: High-pressure finale: combine basalt-crust sextant control with moving crusting basalt vents to chart safe sea lanes between moving shoals by pairing opposite polarity blocks so they lock into stable bridges.
games.implementation2D: Single-screen 2D HTML5 Canvas/JS scene with custom state variables, sprite collisions, and HUD feedback.
games.scope12Hour: Two distinct playable levels, keyboard/mouse input, clear win/lose states, and instant restart.

games.title: Marimba Abacus
games.description: Control mallet-pitch abacus networks within percussion amphitheaters to balance column sums before the ledger locks while unstable floor tiles crumble two seconds after being stepped on, timing every adjustment around off-beat acoustic dampeners.
games.objective: Complete both stages in percussion amphitheaters by working to balance column sums before the ledger locks while avoiding off-beat acoustic dampeners.
games.level1Focus: Single-screen introductory layout in percussion amphitheaters: learn to slide bead counters along a two-node abacus and balance column sums before the ledger locks with no active off-beat acoustic dampeners.
games.level2Focus: High-pressure finale: combine mallet-pitch abacus control with moving off-beat acoustic dampeners to balance column sums before the ledger locks while unstable floor tiles crumble two seconds after being stepped on.
games.implementation2D: Single-screen 2D HTML5 Canvas/JS scene with custom state variables, sprite collisions, and HUD feedback.
games.scope12Hour: Two distinct playable levels, keyboard/mouse input, clear win/lose states, and instant restart.
